info.name: LegalSynq CareConnect - Provider Import
info.description:
Postman collection for the CareConnect provider import feature.

This import endpoint is intended for local development use and does not require authentication.

Feature routes covered:
- `GET /api/networks/{{networkId}}`
- `POST /api/networks/{{networkId}}/providers/import` with `dryRun=true`
- `POST /api/networks/{{networkId}}/providers/import` with `dryRun=false`

Import behavior:
- CSV or XLSX
- max 5 MB
- CSV files are decoded as UTF-8 when the bytes are valid UTF-8 (or a BOM is present); otherwise the parser picks between Windows-1252 and Mac OS Roman -- Excel-on-Windows and Excel-for-Mac plain "CSV" exports each default to a different legacy codepage instead of UTF-8 -- by checking which one turns any stray high bytes into a plausible autocorrect artifact (non-breaking space, curly quote, dash, ellipsis) rather than an arbitrary accented letter; XLSX files use the first worksheet
- max 2,000 data rows
- `tenantId` may be omitted and defaults to the tenant that owns `{{networkId}}`
- supplied `tenantId` values must match the tenant that owns `{{networkId}}`
- each valid row creates/reuses one provider identity, one facility location, and one provider-location network membership
- same NPI plus a different address creates another facility and membership, not another provider
- rows must include at least one active specialty
- ZIP/`postalCode` is required per row unless that row is a mobile provider, so the column itself is optional at the file level

Recommended workbook headers:
`Specialty,Medical Facility,Title,First Name,Last Name,Address 1,Address 2,City,State,ZIP,Email,Phone Number,NPI,Mobile,ServiceRadius`

Canonical headers are also accepted:
`tenantId,title,firstName,lastName,organizationName,npi,email,phone,addressLine1,city,state,postalCode,isActive,acceptingReferrals,specialtyCodes,primarySpecialtyCode,categoryCodes,primaryCategoryCode,latitude,longitude,geoPointSource,isMobile,serviceRadiusMiles`

Specialty values may be codes or seeded names such as `Pain`, `Spine`, `Physical Therapy`, `Neuro`, `Imaging`, `Chiropractor`, and `Extremities`. `Chiro` maps to `Chiropractor`.

Mobile/roaming providers (no fixed street address, e.g. a mobile clinic covering a metro area):
- set `Mobile`/`isMobile` to `Y`/`true` on that row
- ZIP/`postalCode` becomes optional for that row (still required otherwise)
- the address column is stored as a free-text service-area label (e.g. "Greater Las Vegas Metro") instead of a street address
- `ServiceRadius`/`serviceRadiusMiles` (miles) is optional and defaults to 25; both ZIP-based and mobile radii are capped at 60 miles

Alias headers also accepted:
- `Title`/`providerTitle` -> `title`; `First Name`/`firstName` -> `firstName`; `Last Name`/`lastName` -> `lastName`
- `Medical Provider` or `providerName` -> full-name fallback, split into title/first/last when discrete columns aren't supplied
- `Medical Facility`, `facility`, or `facilityName` -> `Facility.Name`
- `Address 2` or `addressLine2` -> appended to `Address 1`
- `organization` or `practice` -> `organizationName`
- `zip` or `zipCode` -> `postalCode`
- `npiNumber` -> `npi`
- `category`, `categories`, `categoryCode`, `providerType`, or `providerTypes` -> `categoryCodes`
- `specialty`, `specialties`, `specialtyCode`, `providerSpecialty`, or `providerSpecialties` -> `specialtyCodes`
- `lat` -> `latitude`
- `lng` or `lon` -> `longitude`
- `geoSource` or `coordinateSource` -> `geoPointSource`
- `mobile`, `ismobile`, or `mobileprovider` -> `isMobile`
- `serviceradius`, `serviceradiusmiles`, `radius`, or `radiusmiles` -> `serviceRadiusMiles`

`geoPointSource` is normalized to `Manual`, `Geocoded`, or `Imported`; common geocoder labels such as `nominatim` are treated as `Geocoded`.

request.description: Validates and previews the import without writing providers or memberships.
Executes the provider import. Reuses providers by exact NPI first, then by same-tenant email, and skips memberships that already exist.
